source._version_note: 2026.10.3 is the latest release (2026-10-21; its RELEASE_NOTES: 'Bump go version'). go.mod declares `go 1.27.3` with no toolchain directive, so the builder is golang:1.27.3-bookworm (upstream's own Dockerfile builds on golang:1.27.3). No go.work. 2026-10-27, 2026.10.4 (2026-10-26): go.mod still declares `go 1.27.3` and upstream's Dockerfile still builds on golang:1.27.3; its RELEASE_NOTES list VULN-176088 (debug endpoint allowlist on the metrics server), klauspost/compress v1.20.3, AUTH-9347 and TUN-11024 (build with the exact Go version from go.mod). BuildTime moved to the 2026.10.4 tag commit's date, 2026-10-26T09:34:58Z (dc3b264d).
source._vendor_note: vendor/ is NOT committed, so the vendor stage runs `go mod tidy -e && go mod vendor`. go.mod carries four replace directives (urfave/cli/v2 -> ipostelnik/cli/v2, prometheus/golang_client, gopkg.in/yaml.v3, and quic-go/quic-go -> chungthuang/quic-go, a fork based on quic-go v0.59.1); `go mod vendor` follows them, as upstream's build does.
source._build_note: Upstream builds with `make cloudflared` (CGO_ENABLED=0, GOFIPS140=off, no build tags on linux/amd64, no -s/-w) and, for its container image, CONTAINER_BUILD=1, which adds -X github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/metrics.Runtime=virtual so the metrics server binds 0.0.0.0 instead of localhost. main.Version is the tag; main.BuildTime is upstream's `date -u -r RELEASE_NOTES` (a checkout's file mtime, so it differs per build); here it is the tag commit's date, so it is the same on every rebuild. A retarget must rewrite the BuildTime literal with the new commit's date.
source.source_date_epoch_provenance: the time release 2026.11.2-CE-ubuntu24.04-r1 was cut (2026-11-23T13:22:29Z), by scripts/retarget.py: ReadyStack dates an image by when its release was packaged (owner 2026-11-10), recorded here once and used by every rebuild of the release; it builds upstream commit dc57315806d5, dated 2026-11-23T11:41:20Z (source.commit_epoch).

binaries_from_source.name: cloudflared
binaries_from_source._note: Upstream's container-build ldflags (see source._build_note). `cloudflared --version` prints `cloudflared version 2026.10.3 (built 2026-10-21T10:51:09Z)`; upstream's release binary printed `(built 2026-10-21-13:11 UTC)`, its build host's file time. /usr/local/bin/cloudflared is upstream's own image path.
